prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in Conroe, Texas, and has shoulder injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1284; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision you reported in Conroe, Texas. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just give you the details, if that's alright. I'm the driver who was hit from behind.

Q: That's fine. Can you walk me through what happened before the impact?

A: I was stopped at a traffic light, waiting for the signal to change. I had been stopped for maybe half a minute when I felt the car get shoved forward hard.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was. The belt locked up and pulled me back, and my right shoulder took most of it.

Q: Did you notice the other vehicle before the collision?

A: No. I was looking ahead at the light. I only saw it in my mirror after it hit me, and by then there wasn't time to do anything.

Q: Did you get out of your vehicle at the scene?

A: I did, but I felt stiff and sore, so I sat down on the curb until the officer arrived. My neck was tight, but the shoulder pain was the worst.

Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the collision?

A: Yes. I went to an urgent care clinic the same evening and was referred to an orthopedic doctor. They told me I might have a soft tissue injury to the shoulder and I'm scheduled for imaging.

Q: Are you currently missing any work because of the injury?

A: I've been limited. I drive for a living, so I've had to take a few days off while I'm getting the shoulder looked at. I'm keeping records of the missed shifts.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything you would like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I want the medical bills and lost wages documented properly. I'm trying to do the right thing here.

Q: Thank you for your cooperation. This concludes the statement.
